description: A Fall 2021 entrant who fails the same course three times. The 2021-2022 calendar has no three-fail rule, so only the attempt limit is raised.

expect.cgpaWorking: CS 1073 F three times: 0 points over 4+4+4 = 12 ch. CS 1303 B: 3.0 x 4 ch = 12 points over 4 ch. 12 points over 16 ch = 0.75, shown as 0.8
expect.warningNotes: Three attempts reaches the attempt limit in the grading rules, and a 0.75 GPA is below the 2.7 the calendar sets for a reduced course load. The three-fail rule that applies from 2022-2023 on is not in the 2021-2022 calendar, so there is no fail-limit warning.

totals.working: only CS 1303 (4 ch) passed; the three CS 1073 attempts are below the C minimum

audit.notes: Every BCS requirement needs a C or better, so all three failed attempts count toward nothing.
